name: Scoped shared issue and PR identity
expected_result: Repository and number identify one shared item; another repository remains distinct; PR extension eligibility requires PR evidence.
required_evidence: Table-driven identity cases and assertion results

name: Sparse numbering and older-item update eligibility
expected_result: An older item remains eligible for update discovery; missing numbers do not cause sequential probing or false deletion.
required_evidence: Discovery decision cases

name: Partial payload merge preserves richer state
expected_result: Arrival ordering cannot downgrade known PR kind, clear newer fields or replace known merged state with incomplete closed state.
required_evidence: Permuted payload results

name: Coverage is separate from freshness
expected_result: Only complete empty resources produce an empty state; fresh metadata does not complete missing comments or files.
required_evidence: Coverage transition table

name: Work schedules and time transitions
expected_result: Work windows, explicit timezone, DST changes and monotonic retries produce the intended next eligibility without replaying missed ticks.
required_evidence: Virtual-clock timelines and boundary cases

name: Independent pause and offline policies
expected_result: Read pause and notification quiet hours do not pause eligible submissions; outbox pause and Work offline block the appropriate work.
required_evidence: Policy truth table

name: Rate-limit and retry budget rules
expected_result: Retry timing honors server budget evidence, caps a retry burst and avoids synchronized retry storms.
required_evidence: Deterministic backoff and header cases

name: Connectivity evidence ordering and freshness
expected_result: Current transport evidence controls reachability; stale replies cannot override a newer state; HTTP authorization/throttle errors remain separate.
required_evidence: Evidence-generation and timeout cases

name: Outbox transition and cancellation invariants
expected_result: Illegal transitions fail; unsent cancellation and uncertain post-send cancellation have distinct durable meanings.
required_evidence: State-machine transition/property results

name: Credential routing and target binding
expected_result: Host, account, owner scope and original target select the credential profile; focus or account changes cannot retarget intent.
required_evidence: Routing and immutable-target cases

name: Diff coordinate and comparison mapping
expected_result: Unified/split and whitespace views preserve original source side, line ranges and immutable comparison identity across edge cases.
required_evidence: Golden source-coordinate cases and property tests

name: PR body issue reference parser
expected_result: Supported closing references normalize and deduplicate; fenced/inline code and arbitrary numbers are ignored; parser output is only a candidate.
required_evidence: Parser fixtures and normalized provenance

name: Workspace routing and stale response rejection
expected_result: Tab-instance identity and selection generation reject late responses and retain independent target and view state.
required_evidence: Routing and reordered-response cases

name: Notification precedence and actor suppression
expected_result: Category enablement, bot suppression, mention exception, own actions, mute, snooze and quiet hours have deterministic precedence.
required_evidence: Rule truth table

name: Notification baseline grouping and deduplication
expected_result: History ingestion does not emit new activity; one event matching multiple categories is deduplicated; catch-up groups eligible events.
required_evidence: Event-sequence and grouping cases

name: Commit ancestry and stable graph layout
expected_result: Parent edges, unloaded boundaries and merge lanes remain valid; mutable branch labels cannot rewrite immutable commits.
required_evidence: Graph fixtures and layout invariants

name: Direct merge policy and expected head
expected_result: Method and revision are immutable; required queues, permissions or changed heads hold the direct-merge intent with an accurate reason.
required_evidence: Eligibility matrix

name: Sidebar totals and zero suppression
expected_result: Count distinct scoped items and unresolved submitted actions; exclude drafts/downloads/terminal history; zero has no badge and unknown is not empty.
required_evidence: Count projection cases

name: Installer platform version and asset selection
expected_result: Select only the expected OS, architecture, version and channel; reject unsafe extraction paths and incompatible downgrade metadata.
required_evidence: Platform/version/path validation cases

name: Secret and private-data redaction
expected_result: Tokens and sensitive payloads cannot enter routine logs, error URLs or exported default diagnostics.
required_evidence: Synthetic secret scanning and redaction cases

name: Test runner selection and report integrity
expected_result: Unknown selectors and zero selected mandatory tests fail; seed, host and status are recorded; blocked or failed cases never become Pass.
required_evidence: Runner self-tests using deliberate pass/fail/blocked cases

name: Real SQLite migrations identity constraints and transfers
expected_result: Real migrations and constraints enforce shared identity. A confirmed transfer updates the locator while retaining stable item identity, drafts and tabs; an unrelated same-number destination item stays distinct. Unresolved transfer evidence cannot silently merge records.
required_evidence: Temporary database snapshots, migration results and transfer relationship assertions

name: Page content and checkpoint atomicity
expected_result: A crash or transaction failure commits both content and progress or neither; restart resumes without missing or duplicate pages.
required_evidence: Injected commit boundaries and restarted database evidence

name: Real FTS search and shared comment ingestion
expected_result: Search uses real FTS indexes, returns scoped distinct items and exposes coverage; ordinary and review comments retain correct identities.
required_evidence: Queries, expected result identities and coverage

name: Production HTTP provider contract
expected_result: REST and GraphQL adapters handle paging, conditional responses, cancellation, partial authorization and malformed errors through real local HTTP.
required_evidence: Redacted simulator request log and parsed outcomes

name: Credential origin and redirect containment
expected_result: Requests never send a PAT to unrelated hosts/owners; unexpected redirects fail without weakening production validation.
required_evidence: Synthetic credential routing and denied destination evidence

name: Incremental sync and old-item changes
expected_result: Restart reuses completed resource-family progress and validators; old closed-item updates are found without mandatory full-history download.
required_evidence: Before/after checkpoints and bounded request trace; PR extension rerun in Sprint 06

name: Shared scheduler budgets and cancellation
expected_result: Duplicate panes share requests; throttle and cancellation preserve other subscribers; required mutation reads obey outbox controls.
required_evidence: Request counts, virtual timing and subscriber outcomes

name: Durable submission versus saved draft
expected_result: Only explicit submission enqueues; failed enqueue never reports Queued and retains input; restart preserves pending previews and target identity.
required_evidence: Real database and simulator mutation count

name: Lost response and completion failure matrix
expected_result: For issue edits, comments, reviews and merges, server acceptance with lost response or local commit failure does not cause blind replay or false success.
required_evidence: Per-action fault point, local receipts and simulator remote state

name: Cancellation versus worker claim and send
expected_result: Transactional cancellation prevents unsent dispatch; post-send cancellation stops attempts but retains honest reconciliation status.
required_evidence: Controlled interleavings and exact mutation count

name: Supported dependent operation recovery
expected_result: Confirmed predecessor receipts survive restart; dependents use real returned identities and hold after cancellation/rejection/uncertainty.
required_evidence: Actual review/thread adapter requests and persisted receipts

name: Existing issue edit conflict preservation
expected_result: Fresh preflight detects conflicting fields and preserves base/local/remote values; an edit failure never creates a new issue.
required_evidence: Conflict snapshots and request trace

name: Review revision and anchor preflight
expected_result: Unchanged queued reviews submit against their intended commit; force-push or invalid anchors hold intent without silent remapping.
required_evidence: Stored anchors, preflight response and request revision

name: Direct merge preflight and reconciliation
expected_result: Current checks and expected head gate the direct merge; required merge queues remain unsupported and retained as blocked intent.
required_evidence: Policy fixture, sent request and authoritative outcome evidence

name: Identity renewal and scope holds
expected_result: Same-user PAT renewal restores eligible work while another account or removed scope cannot inherit or dispatch it.
required_evidence: Credential profile identities, worker claims and persisted scope

name: PR resource coverage and immutable comparisons
expected_result: Separate PR families resume independently; caps/binary/truncated data stay explicit; source content and comparison caches use immutable identities.
required_evidence: Family progress and simulator request assertions

name: Verified linked issues and changing PR bodies
expected_result: Verify target issue type and account/repository scope; changed body or selection discards stale context without retargeting drafts.
required_evidence: Candidate provenance, verified identities and delayed response outcomes

name: Activity observation and persistent delivery decisions
expected_result: Real ingestion discovers configured unopened-item activity, persists baselines and decisions and avoids historical/own-action duplicate alerts.
required_evidence: Observer request logs, feed rows and delivery journal

name: Cleanup migration sign-out and restart durability
expected_result: Cleanup, upgrade and sign-out retain drafts, uncertain actions, receipts, cancellation flags, tabs and checkpoints under their defined policies.
required_evidence: Before/after data inventory and crash-restart results

name: Native protected store and application-data paths
expected_result: Use isolated native secure-store entries and platform data paths; roundtrip, locked-store and deletion behavior preserve cache and redact secrets.
required_evidence: Actual OS backend results and test-owned cleanup report

name: Bootstrap download validation and interruption recovery
expected_result: Exercise actual installer logic with staged metadata/download failures; no corrupt or wrong-target payload activates and existing data remains intact.
required_evidence: Installer subprocess logs, verification decisions and filesystem inventory

name: macOS platform adapter capability contract
expected_result: Mac credential, lifecycle, timezone and notification adapters meet shared contracts with explicit supported actions and permission states.
required_evidence: macOS adapter results and declared capabilities

name: Linux platform adapter capability contract
expected_result: Linux credential, lifecycle, timezone and notification adapters meet shared contracts; absent services/actions produce explicit states and app fallbacks.
required_evidence: Per-session Linux adapter results and declared capabilities

name: Context body and issue reader preserve code state
expected_result: Toggle body/issue, choose linked targets and collapse context without replacing current file/comparison; live inline-draft closure follows Sprint 08.
required_evidence: In-process view state, focus and visible-label assertions

name: Independent panes and shared draft ownership
expected_result: Moving/focusing tabs preserves independent view state, shared draft identity and immutable submitted target.
required_evidence: Framework input events and resulting pane/draft identities

name: Truthful partial offline and error presentation
expected_result: Only the affected resource shows missing/error state; cached content stays usable; status has accessible text as well as color.
required_evidence: Visible-state and accessibility-property assertions

name: Inline review entry and context switch stability
expected_result: Actual inline draft identity, original anchors, text selection and intended target survive context switches and display-only diff changes.
required_evidence: Real view/editor interactions and draft persistence assertions

name: Outbox inspection controls and circular counts
expected_result: All unresolved states are inspectable, eligible cancel controls act correctly and positive circular badges disappear at known zero.
required_evidence: Framework interaction, state projection and geometry assertions

name: Issue creation is absent from all commands
expected_result: Navigation, command palette, shortcuts, draft types and operation capabilities omit New Issue while existing-issue editing/comments work.
required_evidence: Command inventory and attempted interaction results

name: Notification settings expose independent policies
expected_result: Changing one event category, actor rule or delivery mode produces the intended shared rule without hiding the underlying content.
required_evidence: Settings interaction and rule state

name: Keyboard focus and accessible identities
expected_result: Controls have stable IDs, roles and names; focus transitions and editor keystrokes are tested in process without claiming native announcement evidence.
required_evidence: GPUI interaction results and accessibility snapshots

name: Native launch text and pane feasibility
expected_result: External driver launches and operates the actual native window, selects/copies text, resizes panes and types in a real input.
required_evidence: Process/build identity, driver actions and native screenshot; initial Windows gate

name: PAT access and SSO error journey
expected_result: Through native controls, establish a synthetic account, show partial/denied scope accurately and retain profile state without exposing the token.
required_evidence: External UI action log, isolated credential profile and simulator trace

name: Cold offline cached workspace
expected_result: Open implemented cached views, type a draft, exit and relaunch with all networking blocked; workspace and draft return without login/network wait.
required_evidence: UI journey and process restarts, local state and zero prohibited requests

name: Partial discussion and on-demand download recovery
expected_result: A failed later page stays visibly partial; request remaining content and restart/reconnect to resume without duplicates or full archive.
required_evidence: Native visible states and persisted page progress

name: PR body linked issue and code reader
expected_result: Switch body/issue and PR tabs using native controls while responses are delayed; code state is preserved and previous PR context never appears.
required_evidence: Driver steps, selected target and stale-response evidence

name: Offline issue comment submit and cancel
expected_result: Use real editors to submit offline, inspect pending content, restart, cancel an unsent action and reconnect; only eligible explicit submissions reach the simulator.
required_evidence: Native steps, durable rows and remote mutation count

name: Revision-bound offline review submission
expected_result: Enter actual inline review comments, restart offline, then submit an unchanged revision; a changed head holds approval with text and anchors intact.
required_evidence: Editor interactions, stored anchors and submitted commit identity

name: Context toggles preserve an actual review draft
expected_result: While an inline draft is open, toggle/pick issue, resize/collapse, narrow/restore and switch/restart tabs without losing file, selection, draft or target.
required_evidence: Native interaction sequence and preserved draft/position evidence

name: Queued direct merge and current policy
expected_result: Queue merge through UI, reconnect and revalidate; wrong head or queue-required policy holds intent and no local pending state claims merged.
required_evidence: Native Outbox state and simulated remote merge evidence

name: Account change PAT renewal and retained work
expected_result: Sign out/renew through UI, retain local work offline and prevent another account or credential owner from sending the original actions.
required_evidence: Profile/credential transitions and request identity evidence

name: History expansion and labeled comparisons
expected_result: Expand old history, inspect a merge parent and select two commits through native controls; ancestry, labels and current view context remain correct.
required_evidence: Native graph/diff interaction and comparison identities

name: System notification activation after cold launch
expected_result: Actual OS notification activation opens the correct cached item/thread after closing or relaunching the app without replacing another draft.
required_evidence: OS delivery and activation evidence, process and workspace state

name: Schedule and notification controls stay independent
expected_result: Set quiet hours/read pause/outbox pause/Work offline through native controls; each independently controls its intended operations.
required_evidence: Settings journey, native notification observation and request trace

name: Large offline workspace and backlog responsiveness
expected_result: Cold offline views, local search and queue inspection remain usable; cancellation and navigation meet recorded budgets while eligible backlog drains.
required_evidence: Release-build measurements, fixture hash and native journey evidence

name: Native input accessibility and visual acceptance
expected_result: Real keyboard, clipboard, Unicode input, focus, high DPI and supported accessibility actions work; manual screen-reader/visual observations are separately recorded.
required_evidence: OS-specific driver results, screenshots and signed manual observation record

name: macOS full application parity
expected_result: Rerun every applicable common journey on the supported Mac, including native permissions, secure store, lifecycle and packaged activation.
required_evidence: Actual macOS/CPU/display evidence and full common-case result set

name: Linux full application parity by desktop session
expected_result: Rerun every applicable common journey for each promised Wayland/X11 environment with native secure-store, notification and lifecycle behavior.
required_evidence: Actual distribution/CPU/desktop/session/driver evidence and common-case results

name: Native notification denial and capability fallback
expected_result: Denied or missing OS delivery capability preserves the activity feed and task results; unsupported notification buttons remain accessible inside the app.
required_evidence: Actual adapter capability/permission result and native feed evidence

name: No New Issue flow in shipped navigation
expected_result: Native menus, shortcuts, editors and Outbox provide no issue-creation path, while existing-issue edit and comment journeys still work.
required_evidence: External UI/command inventory plus absence of create-issue requests

name: No embedded browser in runtime product
expected_result: The launched release product and enabled dependency/process inventory contain no browser or webview runtime; native Markdown/diff views remain functional.
required_evidence: Packaged dependency/process inventory and native screen evidence

name: Clean installation with at most three commands
expected_result: On a clean supported Windows user profile, the exact published command sequence installs prebuilt binaries and launches the exact candidate artifact.
required_evidence: Command transcript, artifact digest, environment and installed-process identity

name: Repeat installation and repair are safe
expected_result: Rerun the documented installation command; do not duplicate installations, reset preferences or erase cached content, drafts and pending actions.
required_evidence: Before/after install and data inventory

name: Upgrade preserves durable user state
expected_result: Upgrade the prior supported package to the candidate; for a first public release use a documented predecessor test package/schema. Retain cache, drafts, Outbox receipts/pauses, credential references, tabs and checkpoints.
required_evidence: Exact old/new digests, predecessor test-only provenance when applicable, migration logs and offline native restart verification

name: Interrupted or invalid installation recovers honestly
expected_result: Tamper, truncate or interrupt a download/extract/update and inject locked files/full disk; reject invalid payloads and leave recoverable installation/data state.
required_evidence: Fault point, verification failure, installed version and retained-state evidence

name: Exact shipping artifact offline smoke
expected_result: Install the exact production package with no active test hooks; launch against a sanitized preseeded cache offline and verify native navigation, drafts and pending work.
required_evidence: Published-candidate digest, installed binary identity, real UI steps and zero network evidence

name: Uninstall retains data by default
expected_result: Uninstall removes app integration but retains user data by default; explicit data deletion requires the documented choice and protects unresolved-work policy.
required_evidence: Uninstall transcript and retained data/credential-policy inventory

name: macOS published installation and update parity
expected_result: Run at most three published commands on the supported Mac and repeat all applicable package cases against the exact signed/notarized candidate.
required_evidence: Mac package digest, signatures/notarization, install steps and package-case results

name: Linux published installation and update parity
expected_result: Run at most three published commands on supported Linux with declared prerequisites, then repeat package cases and launch under each promised display session.
required_evidence: Linux package digest, prerequisites, desktop/session and package-case results

name: Unsupported downgrade and architecture rejection
expected_result: Wrong-architecture or incompatible database downgrade cannot activate or destructively migrate; the current app/data remains recoverable.
required_evidence: Rejected metadata/version, exit status and unchanged durable-state checks

name: Authorized PAT SSO read validation
expected_result: With explicit read-only opt-in, confirm required endpoint access and identity in the authorized test scope without changing unrelated data.
required_evidence: Redacted endpoint/permission evidence and designated scope

name: Existing issue and comment adapter validation
expected_result: Explicitly authorized mutation cases confirm existing-issue edit/comment behavior, returned identity and reconciliation evidence; no issue-creation fallback.
required_evidence: Designated target, redacted remote receipts and cleanup outcome

name: Review identity and source anchor validation
expected_result: Explicitly authorized reviews and approvals use the verified user identity and intended commit/line anchors against real GitHub behavior.
required_evidence: Remote review identity, commit/anchor receipts and cleanup outcome

name: Permitted direct merge adapter validation
expected_result: Explicitly authorized direct merge validates intended head, method and current eligibility; required-queue repositories do not invoke a merge-queue API.
required_evidence: Designated PR policy, merge receipt or held reason and remote final state
